theme: योगी-परिवार की दुर्लभता / A rare birth in a yogic household.
context: This verse sharpens the previous idea. Krishna does not depict rebirth as trivial. A return in a family of wise yogis is rare, because such an environment can support disciplined practice. The verse invites gratitude for favorable conditions without making outer circumstances the entire measure of spiritual worth.
contextHindi: इस श्लोक में पिछली बात और गहरी होती है। भगवान कहते हैं कि फिर से जन्म लेना कोई साधारण बात नहीं है; योगियों के घर में जन्म लेना बहुत दुर्लभ है, क्योंकि वहाँ साधना के लिए अनुकूल वातावरण मिलता है। यह श्लोक बाहरी स्थिति को कम करके नहीं आंकता, बल्कि योग-उपयुक्त वातावरण का मूल्य बताता है।
sanskritDevanagari:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् |
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम् ||६-४२||
transliteration:
athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām .
etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam ||6-42||

wordByWord.meaning: of yogis; of those who have cultivated yoga
he is born; he comes to be
of the wise, intelligent, spiritually discerning
most rare; even harder to obtain
such as this; of this kind

spokenHindi: यह श्लोक बहुत विनम्रता से कहता है कि योग की साधना के लिए सही वातावरण मिलना भी एक बड़ी पूजा है। भगवान कहते हैं कि अगर कोई व्यक्ति योगियों के घर में जन्म ले, जहाँ बुद्धिमान, संयमी, योग-प्रिय लोग हों, तो यह जन्म बहुत दुर्लभ है। इसका अर्थ यह नहीं है कि किसी परिवार की ऊँचाई या जाति से योग का आकलन होता है। इसका अर्थ यह है कि परिस्थिति, संस्कार और surrounding environment—ये सब जीवन की दिशा को प्रभावित करते हैं। अगर आपके पास ऐसी जगह, अनुशासन, और अच्छे आदर्श हैं, तो साधना सहज हो सकती है। लेकिन इसका मतलब यह भी नहीं है कि जिनके पास वो नहीं है, वे असफल हैं। यह श्लोक सामर्थ्य के साथ humility भी सिखाता है: योग का रास्ता बहुत अनमोल है, और अनुकूल जन्म पाना भी दुर्लभ है।
clearEnglish: This verse is not a social ranking system; it is a reminder that supportive conditions matter. Krishna says that a person may be born in the family of wise yogis, and such a birth is rarer than many ordinary lives. That does not mean spiritual worth is inherited by family line, or that caste, wealth, or lineage is the measure of inner reality. It means that the environment in which a person grows can support or hinder the awakening of discrimination and discipline. For modern readers, the lesson is practical: if we live around clarity, humility, and practice, we can make the next season of life more favorable. Yet the verse also guards against pride, because even a good environment is only a seed; it must be cultivated.

interpretationPerspectives.label: TEXT
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The verse states that a birth in a family of wise yogis is rare in this world. It names family environment, not a universal social hierarchy.

interpretationPerspectives.label: COMMENTARY
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The DLS summary treats this as a rare opportunity for resumed practice, not as a statement that lineage alone makes a person spiritually elevated. An environment of wisdom can help, but it is not the whole path.

interpretationPerspectives.label: INFERENCE
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: Good conditions can aid discipline, but personal effort, ethical clarity, and the desire to practice remain central. A favorable birth is a circumstance, not a guarantee of liberation.

interpretationPerspectives.label: CUSTOM
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: Different families and traditions honor ancestry, rituals, or spiritual inheritance in different ways. Krishna’s wording here is not an instruction to assign spiritual value by family custom or social prestige.

practicalApplication.label: Create a yogic environment
practicalApplication.text: Today, choose one support for your inner life: a quiet corner for meditation, a trustworthy companion who asks honest questions, or a small daily rule that keeps attention from drifting.

reflectionQuestion: How does a supportive environment help practice without becoming a substitute for inward effort and self-discipline?
reflectionQuestionHindi: सही वातावरण साधना में कैसे मदद करता है, बिना inward effort और आत्म-नियमन के स्थान पर आ जाए?
